title: AGUVIS: Unified Pure Vision Agents for Autonomous GUI Interaction
abstract: AGUVIS is a unified vision-based framework for autonomous GUI agents that operates directly on screen images, enabling more natural and generalizable interface understanding. The framework incorporates structured reasoning via inner monologue, allowing the model to develop sophisticated reasoning patterns that emulate human problem-solving processes.

sections.title: The Core Insight
sections.content:
Imagine you're planning a trip from Boston Logan Airport to North Station. You need to interact with a GUI to book your ticket. AGUVIS is a framework that enables autonomous GUI agents to operate directly on screen images, using visual understanding and structured reasoning to navigate complex interfaces.

This approach allows the model to develop human-like interaction patterns and better generalize to novel interfaces.

sections.title: How It Works
sections.content:
AGUVIS operates on a Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP) formulation, where the agent receives an image observation and generates an action through a structured reasoning process. This process involves explicit reasoning about the current state relative to the task goal and previous thoughts.

The agent then executes the action, receives a new observation, and continues until achieving the goal or reaching a terminal state.

sections.title: Benchmark Results
sections.content:
AGUVIS achieves state-of-the-art performance across various benchmarks, including ScreenSpot and Multimodal Mind2Web. On ScreenSpot, AGUVIS-72B achieves an average accuracy of 89.2% across different device and input modalities.

On Multimodal Mind2Web, AGUVIS-72B achieves an element accuracy of 69.5%, operation F1 of 90.8%, and step success rate of 64.0%.

sections.title: Why This Matters
sections.content:
AGUVIS has significant implications for automating GUI tasks, enabling human-like interaction patterns and better generalization to novel interfaces. This framework can be applied to various domains, including web automation, mobile app testing, and desktop application interaction.

By open-sourcing our datasets, models, and training recipes, we provide a foundation for future research in autonomous GUI interaction.

sections.title: Key Innovations
sections.content:
AGUVIS introduces several key innovations, including a unified action space through a plugin system, explicit inner monologue during training, and a two-stage training pipeline that separates GUI grounding from planning and reasoning.

These innovations enable AGUVIS to operate directly on screen images, using visual understanding and structured reasoning to navigate complex interfaces.

sections.title: Try It Yourself
sections.content:
We open-source all datasets, models, and training recipes at https://aguvis-project.github.io to advance future research. Try out AGUVIS on your own GUI tasks and explore the possibilities of autonomous GUI interaction.

Join the community and contribute to the development of AGUVIS, enabling more natural and generalizable interface understanding.
